{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 rows)
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Get the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
highest_mean_species"}
